integrity: Proof establishes the infinite statements; standalone executable checks validate 48,160 finite signed-hash assignments and selected actual preconditioners. Historical general sparse OSE lower bounds are explicitly acknowledged. Priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-arithmetic CountSketch with independent fully random signs and buckets; isometric mean-zero-hyperplane input with optionally padded zero rows; unsafeguarded QR; no claim for general input, multi-sparse sketches, iterative convergence, or universal novelty.
title: Three-valued conditioning and a sharp birthday window for CountSketch QR on mean-zero subspaces
